scenes: Hackers drained a record six point three billion dollar from Binance in history's biggest crypto heist.
Automated scripts siphoned customer wallets in minutes, and Binance froze all withdrawals across the Dubai-based platform.
Blockchain firms quickly unmasked elite North Korean hackers executing the complex attack involving a compromised laptop.
Co-CEO Richard Teng immediately tapped corporate treasuries to buy billions in replacement tokens from the open market.
An astonishing ninety percent of all stolen assets were fully replenished within forty-eight hours using company money.
User balances stayed whole, and withdrawals were set to resume on Sunday, right on schedule.
